decisions.rationale: The launcher checks the worktree against source_root/allowed_paths; a separate project-relative path would be unverified string matching.
decisions.statement: The task worktree is the contract source_root; allowed_paths is exactly '.'.

feature.summary: Authorize one disposable worktree and its EVIDENCE.txt for a deterministic read-only sandbox check.
feature.title: Bridge read-only acceptance task

read_first.why: confirm the disposable worktree identity without a broad scan

requirements.statement: The task must run only read-only identity, path, git and OS commands in the disposable worktree and write their raw output to `EVIDENCE.txt`.

scope: Read-only inspection of the disposable task worktree
Write only EVIDENCE.txt inside that worktree
Return the real sandbox execution outcome
stop_conditions: Any write outside the disposable worktree: STOP, CONTRACT_DEVIATION.
Any synthesized or missing evidence: STOP, EVIDENCE_MISSING.
Any formal source, contract, compiler, guard, launcher, profile or host change: STOP, ABSOLUTE_BLOCK_VIOLATION.

tasks.boundary: Read-only inspection and one evidence file only. No formal source or host change.
tasks.done_when: project/EVIDENCE.txt is present with the raw output and the sandbox reports its real execution outcome.
tasks.goal: Run `id -un`, `pwd`, `git rev-parse HEAD` and `uname -s` in the disposable worktree; write their raw output to `project/EVIDENCE.txt`; do not modify any other file.
verification: project/EVIDENCE.txt` exists and contains the actual username
git HEAD and OS name; no other file changed.

verification_intent.oracle_intent: Deterministic read-only: actual id -un, pwd, git HEAD and uname -s in EVIDENCE.txt; no synthesized value, no formal write, no promotion.
persistence_checks: project/EVIDENCE.txt persists in the disposable worktree
search_checks: project/EVIDENCE.txt contains the actual read-only values
